Strategy: Item-parity gate: even-sized items use tightest fit while odd-sized items use worst fit, preferring the largest residual; this separates the two parity classes into different bin pools, so odd items stop consuming the tight bins even items pack well into. It can fail when parity carries no real size signal and the split just wastes the largest bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) if item % 2 == 0 else r) for r in bins]
```
